Summary of the Committee's assessment, March 2026

Economic developments

Developments in the Norwegian economy are broadly in line with the projections. Unemployment has declined further and is now running at 3.6%. Underlying inflation was estimated at 3.0% in 2026.

International developments

Activity among Norway's trading partners remains moderate. Growth among trading partners is expected to be 1.9% in 2026.

Monetary policy assessment

The Committee assessed that the policy rate should be kept at a restrictive level for longer. The Committee stood ready to adjust the policy rate if necessary. Some members judged that the risks to the inflation outlook were tilted to the upside.
